name: The Blackwood Corrupted
objectiveText: Fill the Empty Cleansing Bowl at the Auberdine Moonwell. Gather a sample of fruit, nut, and grain from the northern Blackwood furbolg camps. Mix the bowl and place it near the bonfire closest to the Cliffspring River at the northern camp, thus summoning the satyr corruptor. Take the Talisman of Corruption and bring it to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine. Talisman of Corruption  ( 1 ) Blackwood Fruit Sample  ( 1 ) Blackwood Grain Sample  ( 1 ) Blackwood Nut Sample  ( 1 )

This is an irritating quest if you lose. When I got back to my corpse he was still there (and it was a little buggy, some of the furbolgs were shifting between green and red), so I sat and rebuffed, and right when I was about to pull him, he disappeared.

You lose the bowl when you use it, so you have to abandon the quest and get it again to get the bowl again to resummon. Pretty annoying.

The items can be found:
Grain: 50, 35
Fruit: 52, 33
Nuts: 51, 33

Once you have all of the items, right-click on the cleansing bowl and you'll see ALL of the Furbies run at you, but don't worry they won't attack you.  I solo'd this as a 17 druid.

What you're looking for is in the containers that look like large, over-turned barrels or drums.  Once you've collected all three, you have to "use" the items beside the bonfire in the center of the camp.  You can't do this while in combat, but once you DO, don't worry about the furbolgs, as they'll become pacified and not attack you (at least for a while).  After about five seconds, Xabraxxis will appear and begin attacking you.  Kill him and take the talisman you loot from his "demon bag" back to Thundris.

It's a fairly hard quest, I died twice doing it. Most of the time it was because I was pulling and then was attacked by 3 or 4 of the level 14 Bears. 

Just pull all the ones near the materials away. gather those, then pull and kill as many in the camp as you can, run in, right click the bowl and then run.

Wait until all the things swarm the bowl, then a red devil looking guy shows up (level 19) yelling about cleansing camps, pull him, kill him, loot his body.

THE TALISMAN IS IN A CRATE NEXT TO HIS BODY, IT ISN'T ON HIS BODY.

Goodluck, 
[pad][div align=center][b]Unsuspected, Level 15 NE Hunter[/b][/div][pad]

This is one of those Classic quests best done with a friend or even a team of friends; or at level 20+. You can solo it at lower levels but be prepared for several things. 1) It's primarily a pulling game so [b]Pull[/b] the Totemics and Warriors away from the storage drums, then run like Hell when 42 additional mobs materialize out of thin air and attack you (they won't follow too far), 2) [b]Pull[/b] the single Warriors and Totemics out of the camp so you can get close enough to the fire, then run away when all the ones you killed before respawn, 3) [b]Pull[/b] the respawns away from the group one by one and kill them again, then 4) [b]Pull [/b]any additional Warriors and Totemics that just seem to have shown up for whatever reason, then 5) Put the Filled Cleansing Bowl next to the fire, heal up as fast as you can when Xabraxxis is yelling whatever he does, then kill him. He's a 19 with no special talents but occasionally he will have an escort or two and that's the end of you. Surprise!

Abraxxis hangs around for awhile so run back and rez (2 time zones but only one plane change), then realize that all the mobs in the camp have now turned red and you don't have the Cleansing Bowl. Dump the quest and spend the rest of the evening wondering how you're ever going to get all that time back. Then you realize that's one of the great things about Classic - it teaches you pretty quickly that life isn't meant to be perfect or even fair. It is what it is; good days and bad days. So bring a friend or two. Or as one of my guildmates did - go back and redo the quest at level 50. No XP but there's that great feeling of completion...

After reading other comments I went in alone as a lvl 19 hunter with my lvl 19 pet nightsabre.  We went from the road along the river's north shore and crossed a fallen tree to get at the camps.  We pulled out blackwoods one by one from the rear of each camp until we could get each of the 3 items.  Did get killed on first try but then just took out as many as possible as quickly as possible to get prizes.  Then went back to correct camp, where all had respawned, and took out more until we could get next to bonfire.  Quickly activated items which drew out satyr who was easy to kill.  All the blackwoods respawned and circled bonfire but left us alone.  We didn't waste time looting everything and tried to run out fast, but EVERYTHING respawned within about 5 seconds of getting talisman, and they first killed my pet then got me.  I resurrected and shadowmelded, then snuck away, revived pet and was still able to loot a few corpses.  While doing quest I hit lvl 20.  It can be done but is probably best accomplished with either a partner or a pet that you know how to use.  Good luck!

To get to this quest you first need to do the three stages of this quest: [quest=984] .  This gets you this quest [quest=4761] and that leads to [quest=4762] and once you complete that you get this quest.

I did this pretty easily as a 20 Priest. I just Mind Soothed the furbolgs guarding each food store, grabbed the food, and ran as the add spawned. To place to food next to the bonfire, I just Mind Soothed everyone nearby and ran as everyone rushed to the bowl. Then the satyr spawned and it was a quick, easy 1-on-1 battle.

My advice to anyone is to go to the right of the camp. (near the mountain range) Attack the bears on that side one by one. Then when you get close to the bonfire make sure there's only one bear guarding it (there's three around it) Because the totum looking thing will make him attack you. You want the least amount of bears around you while you mix the bowl near the bonfire. After this, mix the bowl. (no distractions around you really...) Then all the bears will circle the bonfire and turn good. The guy you need to kill will come out and attack you. If you are a rogue like me, I suggest you use evasion. It helps a bit. For all others, I think if you're a 18 you can deffinitely do it. Also, make sure you get the talisman of corruption. It's in a brown wicker looking basket around the guy. Good luck. ;]

I actually didn't have to do a thing. There were others doing the same quest, I slaughtered the satyr and just opened the basket and that was it. There's plenty of Talisman of Corruptions for everyone so I really didn't consider it as a theft :)
